title: AdaR: A Framework for Equipping LLMs with Adaptive Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2510.04617v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a primary indicator of large language models (LLMs) intelligence. However, existing LLMs exhibit failures in robustness and generalization. This paper attributes these deficiencies to spurious reasoning, wherein generated reasoning traces are driven by superficial correlations, leading models to blindly reproduce memorized patterns from the training data. To address this challenge, we propose the AdaR framework to equip LLMs with adaptive reasoning, wherein models establish correct correlations between query templates and reasoning processes. AdaR automatically synthesizes logically equivalent queries by varying variable values and trains models using Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to penalize spurious logic while encouraging adaptive logic. translated_title: AdaR：一种为大型语言模型赋予自适应推理能力的框架
translated_abstract: 数学推理是大型语言模型（LLMs）智能的主要指标。然而，现有的LLMs在鲁棒性和泛化性方面表现出不足。本文将这些问题归因于虚假推理，即生成的推理轨迹受表面相关性驱动，导致模型盲目复制训练数据中的记忆模式。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了AdaR框架，以赋予LLMs自适应推理能力，使模型建立查询模板与推理过程之间的正确相关性。AdaR通过改变变量值自动合成逻辑等价的查询，并使用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练模型，以惩罚虚假逻辑同时鼓励自适应逻辑。为确保数据质量，我们从原始查询中提取问题解决逻辑，通过代码执行生成相应答案，并……
tldr: AdaR框架通过合成逻辑等价查询并结合RLVR训练，惩罚虚假推理并鼓励自适应逻辑，从而提升LLMs数学推理的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The AdaR framework synthesizes logically equivalent queries and trains LLMs with RLVR to penalize spurious reasoning and encourage adaptive logic, thereby enhancing robustness and generalization in mathematical reasoning.
